title: Midnight Crumbling Thai Falafel
description: A fusion of Thai flavors with a crunchy falafel twist, served with a sweet and spicy sauce to satisfy your midnight cravings.
instructions: 2. In a large bowl, combine falafel, panko breadcrumbs, shredded coconut, crumbled feta cheese, and chopped cilantro.
3. In a small bowl, mix together Thai red curry paste, honey, and lime juice.
4. Add the curry paste mixture to the falafel mixture and stir until combined.
5. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
6. Form the mixture into small balls and place on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
7. Bake for 15-20 minutes or until crispy and golden brown.
8. Meanwhile, make the sweet and spicy sauce by mixing together 1 part honey and 1 part lime juice in a small bowl.
9. To serve, place the falafel balls in a bowl and drizzle with the sweet and spicy sauce.
10. Garnish with additional chopped cilantro if desired.
